description: Shared mixed-base protocol gate vectors (#17091). One rule, two executors: GateProtocolCompat in pkg/upgrade (LANE-1 via targetWireVerdict, PermitUnknownWire; also the documented source of truth) and _gate_mixed_base in scripts/deploy/xpf-deploy.py (LANE-2, RefuseUnknownWire). 'target' is the post-cut binary/image constants; 'missing' lists target keys absent from its protocol-versions/manifest (the gate must fail closed as a target error). 'policy' is refuse|permit (the unknown-wire policy). 'expected' is survive|refuse|error: error = the check cannot run (nil/missing target); refuse = ran and judged incompatible. Consumed by TestMixedBaseGateFixture17091 (Go) and MixedBaseFixture17091Tests (Python). The Python executor judges from string dicts, so peer values arrive as strings; a negative peer wire exercises its _u16 rejection, which the Go side cannot represent in uint16 (Go parse-side rejection is pinned separately by TestParseImageVersions_NegativeSessionSync_FailsClosed). Do NOT retype these vectors into either test — edit this file and both executors together.
